verdict.rationale: Together AI offers an asynchronous Batch API explicitly designed for bulk workloads across many items at once, at up to 50% lower cost than synchronous calls, alongside dedicated endpoints and fine-tuning pipelines that can process large datasets end-to-end. missing for 10: no documented batch size/throughput limits, no independent/hands-on report validating batch job behavior at scale, and no detail on input format flexibility for large item counts.
